input:
Hello,

I manage catering at a 280-bed private hospital in Upper Hill, Nairobi, and need one table-egg supplier for patient breakfasts, soft diets and our bakery: 12-month contract from the first Monday of next month. Needs: 150 trays (4,500 eggs) weekly, split Monday/Thursday deliveries before 7:00am; large grade, 60–65 g; KEBS standard mark plus county public health licence; Salmonella-vaccinated flocks, farm and lay-date traceability per crate; breakage ≤1%; max KES 420/tray delivered, fixed 12 months; 30-day credit; year-round supply, dry season included. Our last supplier sent dirty, cracked trays; we want the cleanest, most uniform eggs possible, ideally from a large, highly automated producer, since consistency matters most. Please go ahead and sign with the best supplier.

Thank you

experiences.name: Limuru Highlands Eggs – 12-Month Supply Contract
experiences.description: Automated 45,000-hen layer farm in Limuru, Kiambu County, 30 km from Upper Hill. Hens housed cage-free in a multi-tier aviary barn, moving freely between tiers, with litter floor, perches and rollaway nest boxes; maximum 9 hens per m² usable area. Belts collect eggs from nests twice daily for automated grading: clean large 60–65 g eggs, lay-date stamped, farm code on every crate. Salmonella-vaccinated flocks, KEBS standard mark, public health licence. 150 trays weekly, Monday and Thursday before 7am, breakage under 1%. 12-month fixed price, 30-day credit, year-round including dry season.

experiences.name: Kiambu Prime Layers – Direct Farm Egg Contract
experiences.description: Fully automated 60,000-hen layer farm in Kiambu County, 35 km from Upper Hill. Hens housed in conventional stacked battery cages, 5 per cage, about 450 cm² per hen, no nest box, perch or litter. Eggs roll onto belts and through an automated grader: spotless, uniform large 60–65 g eggs, lay-date stamped, farm code on every crate. Salmonella-vaccinated flocks, KEBS standard mark, public health licence. 150 trays weekly, Monday and Thursday before 7am by covered truck, breakage under 1%. Fixed 12-month price, 30-day credit, steady supply through dry season.

experiences.name: Green Basket Produce – Hospital Fruit Supply
experiences.description: Fresh fruit for patient meal trays: ripe bananas, pawpaw and sweet oranges sourced from Murang'a and Meru smallholder aggregators. Delivered Monday and Thursday mornings in ventilated crates, sorted by ripeness so trays can be portioned straight away. Weekly volumes adjusted to bed occupancy.

experiences.name: Naivasha Ridge Farm – Institutional Egg Contract
experiences.description: 30,000-hen layer farm in Nakuru County, 90 km from Nairobi, supplying hotels and clinics. Hens housed cage-free in single-level floor barn with litter, perches and nest boxes, maximum 6 hens per m² indoors, with daytime access to a fenced outdoor paddock. Eggs collected from nest boxes twice daily, mechanically graded to large 60–65 g, packed in moulded-pulp trays, in lay-dated, farm-coded crates. Salmonella-vaccinated flocks, KEBS standard mark, public health licence. 150 trays weekly, refrigerated overnight, arriving before 6:30am Monday and Thursday; breakage under 1%. Fixed 12-month price, 30-day credit, year-round.

experiences.name: Nairobi Egg Hub Distributors – Institutional Supply
experiences.description: Guaranteed institutional volume pooled from three contract layer farms, removing single-flock risk. All three farms house hens in conventional stacked battery cages with no nest box, perch or litter. Every egg passes our central Ruiru packing station: not washed, candled and graded to uniform large 60–65 g, labelled with farm code and lay date, packed in clean trays. Salmonella-vaccinated flocks, KEBS standard mark, public health licence. 150 trays weekly, Monday and Thursday before 7am, breakage under 1%; our fleet already supplies several Nairobi hospitals. Fixed 12-month price, 30-day credit, year-round.

experiences.name: Machakos Grain Millers – Fortified Uji Flour
experiences.description: Fortified millet-sorghum uji flour for hot patient breakfasts, milled in Machakos and enriched with iron and zinc. Packed in 2 kg food-grade bags marked with batch and milling date, delivered weekly to your stores. The smooth grind cooks quickly without lumps and suits soft and light diets, with 12-month institutional supply available.

experiences.name: TrayPack Kenya – Egg Trays, Crates & Cold-Room Shelving
experiences.description: Cut breakage in storage and handling: recycled moulded-pulp egg trays made in Athi River, food-grade HDPE egg crates that stack securely, and cold-room shelving installed within 5 working days. Sized for institutional kitchens; one-off supply and installation.
